# fault-injector

> Inject faults into outbound calls in tests: wrap sync or async callables with rules that raise, delay through an injected sleep or return canned values, on deterministic triggers Python package `trysac-fault-injector`, import name `fault_injector`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
